research_question: Can source-blind direct numerical weight growth infer and retain useful previously unenumerated two/three-stage causal Boolean compositions from only observed action-consequence effects, including a withheld non-supplied majority-gate family, without revealing task-specific operator identities?
honesty: Generic split/leaf primitives and universal Boolean representational capacity are supplied. A source-unknown composition is not invention of a new computational primitive. Strong exact symbolic or CART parity defeats any claim of uniquely superior numerical representation.

source.exposed_prior: WSP129/130/131/132/133 old cohorts are fixed reference/negative only; never reclassified as new science
source.new_zero_call_relabel_seeds: 176000..176015 inclusive; 16 renamed views of first 16 known worlds, not 16 unseen laws
source.explicitly_forbidden: All other seeds including 174800..174863,175800..175863,176800..176863,177000..177063 and all original/project protected sources denied before RNG
source.input: six typed binary context/action features x in 0..63; 64 distinct opaque IDs per world; source-only truth and source-only hidden wiring
source.known_generator: SHA256('WSP134|KNOWN|'+seed) seeds Python random.Random; shuffle six distinct input indices p; each of g1 and g2 uses a source-only randomly chosen truth function from AND, OR, XOR, XNOR on p0,p1 and p2,p3; g3 uses source-only AND, OR, XOR or XNOR of g1,g2; output g3 XOR (p4 AND p5) on even-numbered source seeds, else g3 XOR p4. Source-only labels/ops cannot be read by learner.
source.unfamiliar_generator: SHA256('WSP134|UNFAMILIAR|'+seed) seeds Python random.Random; six distinct input indices p; g1 uses source-only AND, OR, XOR or XNOR on p0,p1; g2 similarly on p2,p3; output MAJORITY(g1,g2,p4) XOR p5. MAJORITY is not supplied to model as a named candidate.
source.source_visibility: Learner receives only opaque action IDs, a public typed input x after choosing, and source-verifiable resulting Boolean effect; no seed/original condition/operator identities in model API.

method.candidate: Generic variable-split/leaf binary prediction graph built by source-blind direct numerical weights from actual observed intervention events; dynamically allocate internal nodes, no task-specific gate enumeration or generator module import. Use budgeted deterministic information-seeking probes.
method.independent_symbolic: Separately implemented generic tree/split solver on identical intervention transcript; exact parity on every held output and chosen action required if same policy
method.fixed_policy: Source-blind fixed32 across 64, identical action budget; own model fitted independently
method.conventional: Fully fitted depth<=6 conventional CART on same 32 action/effect events with no hidden labels; record training fit and withheld accuracy. A genuinely strong deep trained baseline remains separately UNQUALIFIED unless explicitly executed.
method.controls: NO_UPDATE; original WSP133 frozen score and old knowledge read-only. Report different policy/training cost, learner capacity, CPU, wall and peak traced memory.
method.intervention_policy: Deterministic source-blind greedily choose unobserved x maximizing current graph uncertainty plus diversity from already queried x, tie lowest x; do not read evaluator or withheld scoring until all 32 paid outcomes are committed
method.retention: Cold-save learned integer graph with SHA256 integrity and replay observed effects; train later unfamiliar worlds, then verify all prior known graph outputs and cold restores unchanged
method.zero_source_transfer: Renamed opaque IDs for first16 known worlds, no new consequences, 64 held each
method.resource: Full action counts, wall/process CPU, tracemalloc, total state weights and source-to-score time; energy not assumed qualified.

frozen_metrics.retention: all64 earlier worlds exactly match before versus after learning the 32 unfamiliar worlds
frozen_metrics.transfer: 1024/1024 predictions match original learned model readouts with ZERO source calls, including abstentions; accuracy scored independently
frozen_metrics.controls: exact source call parity; no numeric/symbolic disagreement if claiming algorithm-equivalence; report same-budget CART and fixed-policy without treating weak controls as proof of superiority
frozen_metrics.development_status: SUPPORTED_ONLY_IF_ALL_THRESHOLDS_AND_CONTROL_CUSTODY_PASS; otherwise DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO; invalid if source leak, altered prereg, missing independent symbolic, extra actions, or replay of protected source
frozen_metrics.scientific_status: SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false for any outcome from this unsealed synthetic development source. No native model admission regardless of score.

prohibited: existing WSP117-133 source or result edits
